text: In CSLib Temporal logic, promoting a derived abbreviation (e.g. allFuture := neg (someFuture (neg .))) to a primitive Formula constructor silently breaks every metalogic proof that relied on the definitional equality via mcs_not_mem_of_neg / mcs_mem_iff_neg_not_mem / `change`. The proofs become type-disconnected, not false. Repair pattern: add sound bridge axioms encoding the classical collapse, then a single MCS-membership iff lemma routed through each defeq break site; downstream consumers stay untouched if the repaired helper lemmas keep their signatures.

CSLib Temporal chronicle Truth Lemma: standalone per-constructor case lemmas (truth_lemma_untl_forward/backward, truth_lemma_imp, truth_lemma_bot) that take their induction hypotheses as explicit arguments can be reused to discharge a NEW primitive operator's truth-lemma case by reconstructing the truth lemma at its classical unfolding, avoiding any new canonical-model/coherence lemma. Derive IHs for neg-phi and top from the IH for phi via MCS negation-completeness, then bridge with a semantic iff and an MCS-membership iff.
